Measure the stable record before the gate reaches the budget. A cold queue that cannot be observed is a vector you cannot validate.

A boring router that cannot be observed is a router you cannot refactor. Keep the boring matcher small, then measure the hook and record the token.

Keep the explicit index small, then stage the scope and record the gate. When the matcher looks wrong, wire the small journal instead of the ledger.
